scenes.headline: How Solar Open 2 keeps a million tokens affordable
scenes.sub: Upstage's 250B-A15B hybrid-attention mixture of experts, layer by layer.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Bongo! Solar Open 2 is Upstage's open mixture of experts, with a million-token context. Here's the layer pattern that makes that affordable.

scenes.text: Three of every four layers are linear attention with a fixed-size state, so only 12 of 48 layers keep a growing KV cache.
scenes.say: The idea: three of every four layers are linear attention, with a fixed-size state. So only twelve of forty-eight layers keep a growing cache.

steps.say: A token climbs forty-eight layers: twelve identical blocks, each one softmax layer followed by three linear-attention layers.
Only the softmax layer keeps a KV cache that grows with every token.

steps.note: Kimi Delta Attention, with negative eigenvalues
steps.say: The linear layers fold the whole past into a fixed-size state. Negative eigenvalues let them erase, and self-correct.

steps.note: order lives in the recurrent state
steps.say: Token order lives in that recurrent state, so there's no rotary position encoding at all.

steps.note: top 8 of 320 routed experts, plus 1 shared
steps.say: And every block is a mixture of experts: eight routed experts plus one shared, so fifteen billion of two hundred fifty billion parameters fire.

scenes.title: KV cache at 1M tokens
scenes.say: At a million tokens, Solar Open 2's cache comes to about forty-eight, against a hundred ninety-two for an all-softmax stack. Four times smaller.

scenes.label: of Solar Open 1's weights carried over; everything else starts random
scenes.note: a selective weight transfer, not depth up-scaling
scenes.say: It's not depth up-scaling. It starts from Solar Open 1, but only two point three percent of those weights fit the new shape.

scenes.text: A quarter of the layers carry the cache. That, not the parameter count, is what makes a million tokens affordable.
scenes.say: So a quarter of the layers carry the cache. That, not the parameter count, is what makes a million tokens affordable.

scenes.say: To recap: one softmax to three linear, twelve caches instead of forty-eight, and a quarter of the memory.
